evidence_boundaries: Cao et al. reports a three-dimensional QED-PIC beam-target concept, not an operating structured-gamma source experiment.
Kennedy et al. is a global electromagnetic GENE study; the reference profiles are not a demonstrated steady STEP operating point.
Liu et al. trains surrogates on one-dimensional implosion simulations; the OOD material results do not establish experimental transfer.
Galeazzi et al. verifies a free-boundary MHD module against analytic and prior-model benchmarks, not a new device observation.
Mignelli and Einkemmer optimize a one-dimensional electrostatic Vlasov-Poisson model without transverse injector physics.
Bonaiti and Sobczyk combines ab initio E1 strength with reaction modeling; it is not a new neutron-capture cross-section measurement.
No QED-PIC, gyrokinetic, implosion, MHD, Vlasov optimization, ab initio or TALYS calculation was reproduced locally.
